children: China's ICICLE named Sabato De Sarno as its creative director on Monday, adding that the first collection completed under the ex-Gucci designer will be its autumn/winter 2027-2028 season.
De Sarno was previously a creative director at the Gucci brand, which is owned by Kering
, the French fashion major which also holds a stake in ICICLE.
De Sarno will oversee ICICLE's creative direction across women's and men's ready-to-wear clothes, as well as accessories and eyewear.
ICICLE is among the Chinese fashion groups which have been hiring European creative talent to raise their profiles.
hired British designer Kim Jones for luxury line AREAL last year, while Hermes-backed
Shang Xia tapped London-based Yang-Li in 2021.
